**Feature Description**  
Please describe the feature you'd like to see on the TV.

**Why Is This Feature Useful?**  
Explain why this feature is beneficial or how it improves TV-Store.

**Additional Context**  
Add any other context, photos of the TV screen, or mockups that help explain your request. If it is about the Apps2Samsung app on your phone or PC instead, please open it in the [Apps2Samsung repo](https://github.com/Apps2Samsung/Apps2Samsung/issues).
